id: title:DanielVisca:pick metrics table columns from a metric search

observations.behavior: Adds an optional prop allowing the widget to use a user-supplied metric name instead of selecting from a dropdown.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes dashboard configuration behavior; users can now enter metrics not present in recent cached lists.

observations.behavior: Renders a button offering the typed name when it is absent from available options, rather than rejecting or ignoring it.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows setting historical or newly created event names without requiring them to exist in warehouse metadata yet.

observations.behavior: Adds tests for custom name generation and its absence on exact matches or empty searches.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression protection against incorrect handling of edge cases in metric naming.}

observations.limitations: Only frontend changes are shown; backend compatibility and complete end-to-end behavior cannot be verified. No tier-3 systemic benefit demonstrated.

review.limitations: Only frontend changes are shown; backend compatibility and complete end-to-end behavior cannot be verified. No tier-3 systemic benefit demonstrated.
review.reason: Substantive bounded capability improvement: adds missing-name support with implementation and tests visible.
review.posthog_relevance: Helps reliability and usability by reducing false negatives when configuring dashboards with older or new events.
review.uncertainty: Could not assess broader system impact or adoption.
